# Feature `distro:ext2`

Distro feature `ext2`:

Include tools for supporting devices with internal HDD/Microdrive for storing files (instead of Flash only devices).

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/features.html#distro-features
